generalAbilities.name: Light Blindness
generalAbilities.description:
See rules...

When first exposed to bright light, the monster is Blinded until the end of its next turn. After this exposure, light doesn't blind the monster again until after it spends 1 hour in darkness. However, as long as the monster is in an area of bright light, it's Dazzled.

defensiveAbilities.name: Void Healing
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

A creature with void healing draws health from void energy rather than vitality energy. It is damaged by vitality damage and is not healed by vitality healing effects. It does not take void damage, and it is healed by void effects that heal undead.

offensiveAbilities.name: Consume Flesh
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements Augrael is adjacent to the corpse of an undead creature that was destroyed within the last hour.

Effect Augrael devours a chunk of the destroyed undead creature and regains 2d6 Healing Damage Hit Points.

He can regain Hit Points from any given corpse only once.

offensiveAbilities.name: Ghoul Fever
offensiveAbilities.description:
Saving Throw DC 20 Fortitude Saving Throw

Stage 1 carrier with no ill effect (1 day)

Stage 2 2d6 Void Damage damage and regains half as many Hit Points from all healing (1 day)

Stage 3 as stage 2 (1 day)

Stage 4 2d6 Void Damage damage and gains no benefit from healing (1 day)

Stage 5 as stage 4 (1 day)

Stage 6 dead, and rises as a Ghoul the next midnight.

offensiveAbilities.name: Paralysis
offensiveAbilities.description: Any living, non-elf creature hit by Augrael's attack must succeed at a DC 20 Fortitude Saving Throw save or become Paralyzed. It can attempt a new save at the end of each of its turns, and the DC cumulatively decreases by 1 on each such save.

offensiveAbilities.name: Sneak Attack
offensiveAbilities.description: Augrael deals an extra 1d6 precision damage to Off-Guard creatures.

offensiveAbilities.name: Swift Leap
offensiveAbilities.description: Augrael jumps up to half his Speed. This movement doesn't trigger reactions.
